caption: The drawing depicts a wooden pendulum clock with a rectangular shape and curved sides at the lower section. The clock is predominantly brown, representing the wood, and has two prominent vertical columns flanking the central body. The upper section features a clock face with a white background, black Roman numerals, and black hour and minute hands, with some faint blue and red decorative marks in the corners of the clock face area. Below the clock face, there is a panel with a decorative pattern consisting of a blue diamond centered within an ornate yellow design on a black background. The lowest section has a glass panel through which a metallic gold circular pendulum is visible, with reflections and light streaks suggesting glass. The whole clock is presented against a plain beige background with no other objects or decorative elements.
title: Clock
